'''Shattered Rock''' canyon was located on [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]]. It was filled with sharp rocks. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] [[Mission to Vaced|fought]] the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Hudu Shiv]] in the canyon.<ref name="SM 3" />

{{Nature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Shattered Rock canyon appears in [[Ryder Windham]]'s [[2011]] novel, ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''.
